address: Šentjošt nad Horjulom 24d, Šentjošt nad Horjulom, 1354, Slovenia
bio: Access to Luka Košir’s house and restaurant is via roads that wind their way through rolling hills dotted with small villages, through verdant landscapes that seem to reflect the restaurants “green” approach to cuisine. The same beautiful views can be enjoyed from the new veranda-style dining room, while fans of fancy culinary techniques will prefer a table facing the brand-new kitchen where they can watch the chefs at work. Here, the owner-chef presents his own seasonal, rural and creative vision of Slovenia via two surprise tasting menus described in terms of the duration of the meal (2hr 30 and 4hr respectively), rather than the number of courses.
